editorial_review_row.author: NAFT Editorial
editorial_review_row.content: STARTRADER is a legitimately multi-regulated broker holding FCA and ASIC licences alongside four additional authorisations — a surprisingly strong regulatory profile for a broker founded in 2012. The $1,000,000 client fund insurance is a genuine differentiator that no other broker at this tier offers, and ECN pricing from 0.0 pips with $7 round-turn commission is competitive in 2026. But the limited Trustpilot sample (832 reviews versus 53,000+ for established competitors), the CNMV Spain warning issued May 2026, at least one documented withdrawal delay, and the relatively short operational history all mean STARTRADER is still in the trust-building phase. The licences are real. The track record is thin. If you value regulatory breadth and low entry cost over years of community validation, STARTRADER deserves consideration — but test the withdrawal pipeline with small capital before committing anything you cannot afford to wait for.
